seo.title: Recognition & Awards - Oceans Alive Foundation
seo.description: UNDP Equator Prize, King Charles III Royal Visit, IUCN World Conservation Congress 2025 - global recognition for community-led marine conservation.

AWARDS.title: His Majesty King Charles III
AWARDS.body: His Majesty King Charles III personally visited the Kuruwitu project, launched a coral restoration block bearing his royal cypher into the waters, and endorsed the community-led conservation model to a global audience of millions.
AWARDS.highlight: Royal endorsement carried the work of Kilifi's fishermen to every corner of the world.

AWARDS.title: UNDP Equator Prize 2017
AWARDS.body: Kuruwitu CBO wins the prestigious UNDP Equator Prize for exemplary community-based approaches to conservation and sustainable development - placing the community-led model on the world stage of environmental leadership.
AWARDS.highlight: One of the world's most recognised prizes for grassroots environmental action.

AWARDS.title: IUCN Blue Champions Award 2022
AWARDS.sub: International Union for Conservation of Nature
AWARDS.body: Kuruwitu CBO wins the 2022 IUCN Blue Champions Award, recognizing outstanding ocean conservation leadership and two decades of proven community-driven marine protection delivering 400% fish biomass increase and 30% coral recovery.
AWARDS.highlight: Global recognition for champions protecting our ocean for future generations.

AWARDS.title: The UN Appreciates Kuruwitu's Efforts on Coral Restoration
AWARDS.body: UN News recognised the efforts of Kuruwitu's villagers to combat coral degradation, with Oceans Alive at the helm of the coral-based Locally Managed Marine Area (LMMA). Kenyans.co.ke published an article commending the work.
AWARDS.imageAlt: Delegates in a United Nations conference hall

AWARDS.title: United Nations Food Systems Game Changer
AWARDS.body: Recognized as a Food System Game Changer for innovative community-led approaches linking ocean health, fisheries management, and food security in coastal communities.
AWARDS.highlight: Transforming how communities manage ocean resources for sustainable livelihoods.

AWARDS.title: World Economic Forum - Uplink Top Innovator
AWARDS.body: Selected as a top innovator by the World Economic Forum's UpLink platform for scalable ocean conservation solutions.
AWARDS.highlight: Global recognition for innovation in marine conservation.

AWARDS.title: IUCN World Conservation Congress
AWARDS.sub: International Union for Conservation of Nature
AWARDS.body: Presented the Kuruwitu community co-management model as a globally scalable blueprint for marine governance at the world's largest conservation forum.
AWARDS.highlight: From 30 hectares to a global template - Kuruwitu on the world stage.

hero.title: Recognised
hero.label: By the World.
hero.text: Every award, prize, and royal visit reflects the work of the fishing communities of Kilifi County - not just our organisation.

quoteStrip.text: “These recognitions celebrate the dedication of Kilifi's coastal communities.
quoteStrip.label: Their commitment to ocean stewardship is what makes this work possible.
